title: Puzzle 3D Selection Freeze
description: Eliminate ~6s UI freeze when selecting an object in puzzle 3D play harness by routing hierarchy selection through Tree selectedIds instead of rebuilding 538-node tree.
summary: Hierarchy selection no longer rebuilds ~538 tree rows on every click. Structural sections are cached per fixtureRevision; selection flows via UiTreeNode.selectedIds into Tree's per-id store. PlaygroundDeclarativeTree memoizes TreeData by stable sections identity. Fixed missing BRUSH_PLACEMENT_COLLISION_TOLERANCE_MAX import in play controller.
